changeSet.sql: -- Internal, not public: read only by the publish check -- (MarketplaceApi) and joined by the public views below. Nothing -- here is ever serialized to a buyer. CREATE VIEW marketplace_estate_eligibility WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT e.id AS estate_id, e.published AS published, (o.verification_state = 'VERIFIED') AS tenant_verified, o.marketplace_publishing AS tenant_entitled, (o.status = 'ACTIVE') AS tenant_active, -- CASE short-circuits, so the conflict function only runs for -- estates that already pass the four cheap conditions. CASE WHEN e.published AND o.verification_state = 'VERIFIED' AND o.marketplace_publishing AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN (SELECT s.blocking_count FROM landvault_estate_conflict_summary(e.id) s) = 0 ELSE false END AS eligible FROM estates e JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.tenant_id AND o.deleted = false WHERE e.deleted = false;
